estimator.targets: Independent x/y residuals about the refitted role-conditioned baseline.
estimator.optimization: Use the validated fixed capacity; no additional parameter search.

preprocessing.baseline: Refit on all training_games; never reuse research fitted coefficients.
preprocessing.history: Recompute raw constant-velocity residual encodings, smoothing 20, from strictly earlier training dates; exclude the whole current date. Freeze evaluation lookup.
preprocessing.routes: Refit 16 route components and eight prototypes on training_games only.
preprocessing.columns: Preserve each frozen ordered schema; no screening or reselection.
preprocessing.export: Prune after fitting, with full-row original/portable prediction parity.

evaluation.aggregation: Pool coordinate squared errors; never average game or week RMSEs.

confidence_interval.scope: Game sampling uncertainty within this single labelled season.

evaluation.decision_rule: Report the frozen model regardless of score; no holdout model selection.
evaluation.release_rule: Seal the protocol, fitted model, inference sources and all keyed predictions before opening holdout outcomes. Resume only the same sealed evaluation. A failed run does not authorize a different model; an error correction must retain its audit trail.
evaluation.gateway: Verify final package/standalone parity using the unchanged organizer gateway.

remaining: Execute and checkpoint the final preprocessing and two availability-profile fits.
Seal final model and predictions; implement and run the reserved evaluation.
Verify final raw/standalone/gateway parity and publish final notebook evidence.
